# Rule B7: Leave room for doubt During roleplay, drawing conclusions based on meta-knowledge when faced with ambiguous in-character information is not allowed. [italic]“When you hear hoofbeats, think horses, not zebras.”[/italic]
- Your character may be suspicious, cautious, and prepared when appropriate. - Do not assume or act as though a specific antagonist is present without direct in-character evidence. - Do not use meta-information that certain events only happen due to specific antagonists or gamemodes when other reasonable in-universe explanations might exist. - When allowed by the [textlink="metashield" link="DeltaVRule2"], your character may be aware of outside entities and factions (the Cosmic Cult, Space Dragons, Syndicate Robo-Neuroticists, …), although they should not be treated as common, everyday occurrences. - Do not assume the shift will go badly without reason.
## Examples: Allowed: - Asking “Do you think there could be a cult?” when an “abnormal Λ-CDM increase” event happens. - Increasing security readiness in response to an “Unauthorized Announcement”. - Saying “I heard a zombie near logistics.” when a zombie growl is heard. - Increasing security readiness/investigating/alerting others when unknown Borgs are visible on the robotics console. - Assuming webs on the floor were created by tarantulas. - Knowing weaknesses/abilities of a specific antagonist.
Prohibited: - Asking “Did anyone see any cultists yet?” when an “abnormal Λ-CDM increase” event happens. - Saying “There is a lone operative.” (or "nukie") when a non-threatening “Unauthorized Announcement” is made. - Assuming Xenoborgs are on the station or arming because an airlock has Xenoborg access. - Saying “There is a SRN.” because unknown Borgs are visible on the robotics console.
